request: The generic Counter and Gauge must be safe for 64-bit atomic operations on 32-bit platforms such as ARM: every field they access with sync/atomic 64-bit functions must sit at an 8-byte aligned offset under 32-bit struct layout.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: metrics/generic: fix uint64 alignment (#1007)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > metrics/generic/generic_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestAtomicAlignment)$' ./metrics/generic >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
